title: Judge blocks the Trump administration from moving FBI headquarters to DC office building
summary: A U.S. judge has blocked plans to move the FBI's headquarters to a federal office building in Washington. The decision finds that President Donald Trump's administration illegally discarded a previously approved plan to build a new facility in Maryland. The ruling is the latest development in a long battle over the FBI's main office location. A site in Greenbelt, Maryland, was chosen during former President Joe Biden's administration. Trump appointees later sought to reverse that decision. Maryland and Prince George's County brought the suit.
